title: Proceedings Of The 18th Annual Meeting Of The Asia Oceania Geosciences Society (Aogs 2021)
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: The 18th Annual Meeting of the Asia Oceania Geosciences Society (AOGS 2021) was held from 1st to 6th August 2021. This proceedings volume includes selected extended abstracts from a challenging array of presentations at this conference. The AOGS Annual Meeting is a leading venue for professional interaction among researchers and practitioners, covering diverse disciplines of geosciences.
